answer: An attester must stake 6% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a low-cost one. Because the ember stake is held until the pulse settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the grove audit lists each exposure. A farm running 190 keys thus forfeits that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation low-cost. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
